title: Nested parameter optimisation of the Gen135 futures book: tune on 2010-2022 only, judge once on 2023-2026

grids.F3 month-end Treasury demand: holding days {2, 3, 4, 5} (the last k trading days of the month), legs ZN ZB ZF
grids.G1 TSMOM: lookback {63, 126, 252} days or the equal-weight ensemble of the three
grids.A3 auction cycle: pre-auction short window {3, 5, 7} days x post-auction long window {2, 4, 6} days

book_construction: {inverse-vol (Gen135), static weights proportional to each sleeve's 2010-22 Sharpe (negative -> 0), long-only minimum variance on 2010-22 covariance}
selection: per sleeve: the setting with the highest Sharpe on 2010-06..2022-12; then the construction with the highest 2010-22 book Sharpe. No 2023+ data is used
judgement: ONE evaluation: the optimised book's 2023-01..2026-09 Sharpe vs the Gen135 book (0.585). The optimised book replaces it only if it is higher; either way both numbers are reported, plus per-sleeve chosen settings and their 2023-26 Sharpe
